modelNotes: Points Board 1.3 reads from nba_core.json, nba_minutes_engine.json, and nba_usage_engine.json.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: This isn't the first mention of Jerome's nagging back issue, though it didn't stop him from suiting up for the 124-103 win over the Trail Blazers on Thursday. The 29-year-old has played at an All-Star level in his five regular-season appearances in 2026-27, averaging 25.8 points, 2.2 rebounds and 5.8 assists, all career highs, along with 1.0 steals in 29.8 minutes per contest. With that in mind, if Jerome can't get on the floor Saturday versus Sacramento, Cam Spencer and Scotty Pippen (back) are candidates for more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
injury.detail: Sengun will miss a second consecutive contest due to lower-back soreness, opening up additional minutes in the frontcourt for Tari Eason and Clint Capela. Sengun's next chance to play will come Saturday against the Thunder in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

injury.shortComment: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: Brown is sitting out the first leg of this back-to-back set, and he figures to be facing a short-term absence. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Dean Wade should see more playing time, while Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James are all in line to handle more usage.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (rest) closed Friday's 98-93 victory over the Knicks with 10 points (3-12 FG, 0-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds, seven assists, one block and one steal in 33 minutes.
injury.detail: Embiid didn't have a great shooting night Friday, but he did fill up the box score and finished second on the 76ers in assists behind LeBron James (eight). Through five regular-season games, Embiid is averaging 19.2 points, 9.4 rebounds, 5.2 assists and 1.0 blocks over what is currently a career-high 35.2 minutes per contest. It wouldn't be surprising to see the veteran center sit for the second leg of the Sixers' back-to-back set Saturday against the Hornets.

injury.shortComment: James (rest) closed with 20 points (8-15 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-3 FT), nine rebounds, eight assists, one block and one steal across 34 minutes during Friday's 98-93 win over the Knicks.
injury.detail: James was close to securing his first triple-double of the season, as he led the 76ers in both rebounds and assists while finishing second in points behind Tyrese Maxey's 27. Friday was the first game of the 76ers' back-to-back set, so it wouldn't be surprising to see James operate on a minutes restriction or be held out of Saturday's road tilt against the Hornets. James is averaging 16.4 points, 7.0 rebounds, 7.0 assists, 1.6 steals and 1.0 blocks over 33.4 minutes per game to open the regular season.

injury.shortComment: Markkanen (wrist) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Markkanen suffered a right wrist sprain during the 110-105 loss to Memphis on Monday. As a result, he didn't play in Wednesday's meeting with the Spurs. While subsequent tests have been encouraging, the veteran should still be considered day-to-day. If Markkanen misses another contest, Josh Green could remain in the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
injury.detail: A foot injury could cost Thomas a second straight contest Saturday. Sam Merrill could pick up a few extra minutes off the bench if Thomas is unable to suit up.

injury.shortComment: Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.
injury.detail: This decision is a no-brainer after the Rockets chose Sheppard in the first round of the 2024 NBA Draft. Sheppard, who remains out for Friday's game versus Dallas, is a key cog in the backcourt rotation when healthy.

injury.shortComment: Williams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Jazz.
injury.detail: Williams missed Thursday's game against the Grizzlies,  but since the decision was precautionary, the upgrade to questionable suggests the veteran center has a chance to play Saturday. Williams is averaging 9.7 points and 8.7 rebounds per game, and if he's available, he should be the primary backup at center behind Donovan Clingan.

injury.shortComment: Post (ankle) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: A right ankle sprain is expected to cost Post at least one contest. Assuming he's eventually downgraded to out, more playing time should fall into the hands of Isaiah Stewart as the No. 2 center Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Pippen (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: Pippen has appeared in all five of the Grizzlies' regular-season games, though he's now in danger of missing Saturday's meeting with Sacramento. With Ty Jerome (back) also questionable, Pippen might find himself in the starting lineup. However, if neither of those players can suit up, Cam Spencer may get the start.
